plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Office Wordle, Higher / Lower and live drawing rooms inside your IDE. Native Swing compatibility edition for JetBrains IDEs 2019.1–2019.3, with Java 8 support. Requires the office Arcade Machine server.
plugin.change-notes: Compact native drawing interface for IDEs 2019.1-2019.3. Icon-only pen, eraser, line, rectangle and ellipse tools; one color button opens RGB sliders and sixteen presets. Shape previews synchronize on release and support whole-gesture undo. Drawing rooms hide redundant text and exhausted hint controls during play.
